<script>
(function(w,d){
  if(w.__arkanGtmListenerInstalled)return;
  w.__arkanGtmListenerInstalled=true;
  var last={};
  function emit(name,data,key){
    var now=Date.now(),k=key||name;
    if(last[k]&&now-last[k]<1000)return;
    last[k]=now;
    w.dataLayer=w.dataLayer||[];
    var payload={event:name,page_path:w.location.pathname};
    data=data||{};
    for(var p in data){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data,p))payload[p]=data[p];}
    w.dataLayer.push(payload);
  }
  d.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var node=e.target;
    var a=node&&node.closest?node.closest('a'):null;
    if(!a)return;
    var href=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').trim();
    var text=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    if(/^tel:/i.test(href)){
      emit('click_call',{click_url:href,click_text:text},'call:'+href);
      return;
    }
    if(/(?:wa\.me|api\.whatsapp\.com|whatsapp\.com)/i.test(href)){
      emit('click_whatsapp',{click_url:href,click_text:text},'wa:'+href);
    }
  },true);
  d.addEventListener('arkan:lead-success',function(e){
    var x=e&&e.detail?e.detail:{};
    emit('lead_form_success',{
      landing_page_id:x.landing_page_id||'',
      lead_token:x.lead_token||'',
      duplicate:!!x.duplicate
    },'form:'+(x.lead_token||'success'));
  });
})(window,document);
</script>
